title: Allocation must cover the estimated cost
description: Estimated cost (GPU-hours x QOS multiplier, or SUs) must not exceed the remaining balance of the lab's allocation on the target cluster. ACCESS awards have no automatic refills.

title: Allocation expiring within 30 days
description: Warn when the allocation used for the run ends within 30 days; Anvil project storage is purged 90 days after an allocation expires.

title: Run must finish before the project deadline
description: Expected queue wait (p90) + estimated runtime x 1.2 must end before the linked project deadline.

title: GPU jobs must actually use their GPUs
description: RCAC logs power, memory and utilization of every GPU every 10 seconds and identifies users who request large amounts of GPU hours but do not use them. Jobs averaging under 10% GPU utilization are flagged; keep-alive fake workloads are prohibited.

title: Regulated data stays on Purdue-owned resources
description: Human-subjects / data-use-agreement data may only be processed on Purdue-owned clusters and Purdue storage; third-party cloud requires a separate data-use review.

title: Export-controlled data only on approved resources
description: EAR/ITAR-controlled data may only be processed on resources listed in the lab's Technology Control Plan and only by authorized persons; never on national (ACCESS) or commercial cloud resources.

title: Fair-share: labs far above their share are deprioritized
description: When a lab's trailing-30-day usage exceeds 1.5x its fair-share target, new normal-priority runs get a warning and standby/preemptible alternatives are suggested.

title: Submit through Slurm, not login nodes
description: All work must be submitted through the scheduler (sbatch, sinteractive, Open OnDemand); computation on login nodes is not allowed. Be as accurate as possible about requested resources.

title: Anvil GPU caps: 12 per user, 32 per allocation
description: Anvil gpu and ai queues: maximum of 12 GPUs in use per user and 32 GPUs in use per allocation.

title: Anvil scratch purged after 30 days, no warning
description: Files on Anvil scratch not accessed in 30 days are deleted instantly and automatically with no warning emails. Copy results to project storage / Depot.

title: Gautschi scratch purged after 60 days
description: Files not accessed or modified in 60 days are purged; scratch quota 100 TB / 2,000k files; home 25 GB.

title: Gilbreth scratch purged after 60 days; home not shared
description: Gilbreth scratch is purged after 60 days without access; Gilbreth home is not shared with other clusters, so input data must be staged on Gilbreth scratch or Depot.

title: Bell is decommissioned
description: Bell was retired on 2026-10-31 (scratch unrecoverable after 2026-10-30 17:00). No new jobs; use Gautschi.

title: Third-party cloud: data leaves Purdue
description: Runs on AWS move data outside Purdue; allowed only for non-sensitive data and charged to lab cloud credits.

title: Anvil maximum job size 7,168 cores (56 nodes)
description: Larger jobs require a support ticket.

title: Gilbreth jobs must request memory (--mem)
description: Since the 2025 Slurm modernization every Gilbreth job needs account, partition, QOS and an explicit --mem.

title: Gautschi ai normal QOS: max 4 days (since 2026-11-02, was 14 days)
description: Requested walltime must be <= 96 h on Gautschi ai (H100, normal). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gautschi ai preemptible: max 30 days
description: Requested walltime must be <= 720 h on Gautschi ai (preemptible 0.25x). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gautschi ai burst: max 8 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 8 h on Gautschi ai (burst 2x). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gautschi smallgpu: max 24 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 24 h on Gautschi smallgpu (L40S). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gautschi cpu normal: max 14 days
description: Requested walltime must be <= 336 h on Gautschi cpu. Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gilbreth normal QOS: max 14 days
description: Requested walltime must be <= 336 h on Gilbreth a100-80gb. Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gilbreth standby QOS: max 4 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 4 h on Gilbreth a100-80gb (standby QOS). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gilbreth training partition: max 24 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 24 h on Gilbreth training (>2 GPUs). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Anvil gpu: max 48 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 48 h on Anvil gpu (A100). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Anvil ai: max 48 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 48 h on Anvil ai (H100). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Anvil wide: max 12 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 12 h on Anvil wide. Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Anvil gpu-debug: max 30 minutes
description: Requested walltime must be <= 0.5 h on Anvil gpu-debug. Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Anvil wholenode: max 96 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 96 h on Anvil wholenode. Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Negishi gpu: max 24 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 24 h on Negishi gpu (MI210). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gilbreth a30 standby QOS: max 4 hours
description: Requested walltime must be <= 4 h on Gilbreth a30 (standby QOS). Longer runs must checkpoint and chain (--dependency=afterok) or use a longer QOS.

title: Gautschi ai burst: max 8 GPUs, 1 job per account
description: Burst QOS (highest priority, charged 2 GPU-hours per GPU-hour) allows one burst job per account and at most 8 GPUs.

title: Gautschi ai normal: concurrent GPUs <= max(2, 2x purchased)
description: Since 2026-11-02 an account may use at most max(2, 2 x purchased GPUs) H100s concurrently in normal QOS (was a flat 24 per account).

title: Preemptible QOS requires checkpointing
description: Preemptible jobs (0.25x charge) can be cancelled/requeued for normal jobs with a 10-minute grace signal. Use --signal=B:USR1@600 --requeue and checkpoint at least every 30 minutes.

title: Gautschi smallgpu: max 2 GPUs in use, 8 submitted
description: Bonus L40S partition; request cores proportional to GPUs.

title: Gilbreth training: for workflows needing >2 GPUs
description: Training partition is for groups that demonstrated workflows needing more than 2 GPUs at once; jobs with <= 2 GPUs should use the regular partitions. Older limit: 2 concurrent jobs, 8 GPUs per user.

title: Anvil gpu-debug: max 2 GPUs, 1 running job
description: Debug queue for short tests.

title: Standby has no start-time guarantee
description: Standby jobs run on idle GPUs at low priority, are free (not withdrawn from the account) but may take hours or days to start; avoid when deadline slack < 24 h.

title: Licensed corpus stays on Purdue storage (data-use agreement)
description: ClinNotes data is covered by a hospital data-use agreement: no AWS or other cloud.

title: Runs over 500 GPU-hours need PI approval
description: Any single run estimated above 500 GPU-hours requires PI approval.

title: NLP lab: A100/H100 only (bf16 + FlashAttention-2)
description: Lab code requires bf16 and FlashAttention-2.

title: Final/thesis runs never on preemptible or standby
description: Priority-1 project runs must use normal QOS; sweeps may use standby.

title: Restricted collaborator cryo-EM maps: Gilbreth only (demo scenario)
description: Simulated data agreement: the collaborator's unpublished maps may only be processed on Purdue-owned Gilbreth nodes under the lab account - never on Anvil/ACCESS or any cloud.

title: Robotics: Gilbreth A30s reserved weekdays 9-17 ET
description: Lab's 2 A30s are reserved for students debugging on the real robot during weekday working hours; batch training should use Gautschi preemptible or smallgpu then.

title: Robotics: >8 GPUs needs PI approval
description: Ask the PI first.

title: Chem: exploratory sweeps use standby
description: Exploratory MD/DFT sweeps should use standby or preemptible QOS; production FEP may use normal.

title: Ag: hold AWS jobs at 95% of cloud credits
description: When AWS research credits reach 95% used, new AWS jobs are held and the PI is notified.

title: CV: avoid A30/A10 (models need >=40 GB)
description: OV3D-Seg needs >= 40 GB per GPU.

title: Physics: scale down instead of idling
description: If any GPU sits idle >30 min, scale the job down rather than burn the bank.
